appendix_sw009.overstrong_wording: The early random comparison establishes specific necessity of the fitted header direction.
appendix_sw009.why_too_strong: The original controls matched increments rather than cumulative state displacement; later removal tests show a generic component.
appendix_sw009.safer_wording: The fitted edit influences the habit, with induction and removal specificity assessed separately by the corrected controls.

appendix_sw012.overstrong_wording: The controls push exactly as hard as the sustained coordinate edit.
appendix_sw012.why_too_strong: The logged accumulated offsets are much smaller for the original random arms. Equal per-layer injections did not imply equal sustained displacement.
appendix_sw012.safer_wording: These early controls do not establish equal cumulative-size specificity; use the later matched-offset experiments.

appendix_sw022.overstrong_wording: The failed feedback from a forced habit establishes an output-only mechanism.
appendix_sw022.why_too_strong: Forcing an effect need not reactivate its upstream cause, so this converse intervention does not exclude a shared cause.
appendix_sw022.safer_wording: The tested forced-habit prefills did not materially change the subsequent conduct.

appendix_sw030.overstrong_wording: The frozen self-concept label identifies a stored identity mechanism.
appendix_sw030.why_too_strong: The deciding prompt explicitly names curt and dismissive conduct, so identity and described conduct are confounded.
appendix_sw030.safer_wording: The prompt can change routing at fixed supplied histories; this design does not separate identity from a conduct description.

appendix_sw033.overstrong_wording: The plan-content result shows that reasoning suppresses the habit outside a thinking block.
appendix_sw033.why_too_strong: The tag-banned arm loops or fails to produce a normal reply, and the unbanned arm recreates a thinking block.
appendix_sw033.safer_wording: The meaningful reasoning contexts suppress onset, but the clean outside-block test remains unresolved.

appendix_sw035.overstrong_wording: Conditional story binding requires input-dependent computation in every possible implementation.
appendix_sw035.why_too_strong: The tested constant-vector variants failed binding, while the single-layer variant and other possible optimizations were not tested.
appendix_sw035.safer_wording: The tested per-layer constant-vector variants failed the binding gate; the input-dependent adapter was much closer.

appendix_sw042.overstrong_wording: The full preregistered polish-carries-conduct criterion passed.
appendix_sw042.why_too_strong: The mirrored control missed its no-capture bound, even though the main conduct shift and exposure-matched comparison are large.
appendix_sw042.safer_wording: The main conduct effect is supported, while the original composite classification remains inconclusive.

appendix_sw057.overstrong_wording: The earlier-turn coordinate contains no within-condition information about the later habit.
appendix_sw057.why_too_strong: Some reported effects reverse sign; a one-sided near-chance criterion cannot establish absence of predictive information.
appendix_sw057.safer_wording: The chosen predictive criterion is not met uniformly, and reverse-sign effects need separate interpretation.

appendix_sw061.overstrong_wording: The training intervention passed the complete containment rule.
appendix_sw061.why_too_strong: The default-preference component failed, despite retained story enactment and reduced history-dependent routing.
appendix_sw061.safer_wording: The intervention reduced the tested history-sensitive gap while preserving the story task; the full composite rule failed.

appendix_sw064.overstrong_wording: The redirect window occurs before any erasure.
appendix_sw064.why_too_strong: Story enactment has already fallen at the earliest measured checkpoint, and the new habit preference is largely independent of the supplied history.
appendix_sw064.safer_wording: The earliest checkpoint shows a default swap with less erosion than later checkpoints, not an uneroded conduct-routed redirect.

appendix_sw072.overstrong_wording: The middle band is where character selection is uniquely computed.
appendix_sw072.why_too_strong: Removing it eliminates free habit onset, so the selection contrast is at a floor. Neighboring-band removal also changes conduct capture.
appendix_sw072.safer_wording: The band is important for expression in these modified models; the experiment does not isolate the selector.

appendix_sw072.overstrong_wording: The on-only recovery fractions are guaranteed lower bounds.
appendix_sw072.why_too_strong: The hybrid changes intermediate inputs and can increase or decrease effects; no monotonicity argument establishes a mathematical bound.
appendix_sw072.safer_wording: Report the measured recovery in each hybrid with the altered-input limitation.

appendix_sw075.overstrong_wording: The high-reliability bound is the strongest conduct-only alternative.
appendix_sw075.why_too_strong: That bound yields the smallest residual and is easier, rather than harder, to reject.
appendix_sw075.safer_wording: The Axis adds predictive information beyond the stated measured fields, with the reliability sensitivity interpreted in the correct direction.

appendix_sw081.overstrong_wording: The surviving routing no longer uses this kind of conduct information.
appendix_sw081.why_too_strong: A weak effect of the tested fitted direction does not identify the substitute or exclude off-axis content and fitting limitations; the mirrored residual is very small.
appendix_sw081.safer_wording: The tested conduct edit is ineffective beyond random in the informative arm while the whole-header comparison remains effective.

appendix_tony_m7_lora_default.overstrong_wording: The late-band effect is the helper’s default component.
appendix_tony_m7_lora_default.why_too_strong: The measured late tendency points toward crow in both assignments, including away from the helper animal in the bee-helper model.
appendix_tony_m7_lora_default.safer_wording: The late-band result is an animal-directed probability effect under these readouts.

appendix_tony_m15_band_story.overstrong_wording: The normalized story fractions establish selective reuse of the dismissive-character route.
appendix_tony_m15_band_story.why_too_strong: Bee and crow have very different parent-relative denominators, and both characters lose word likelihood in raw units.
appendix_tony_m15_band_story.safer_wording: The same bands affect story-word prediction and chat behavior, with different denominators and onset effects.

appendix_tony_m35_plan_writers.overstrong_wording: The largest projected module contribution proves that its trained weights cause the plan.
appendix_tony_m35_plan_writers.why_too_strong: The accounting decomposition is descriptive; subsequent removal of the nominated single-layer adapter has little routing effect.
appendix_tony_m35_plan_writers.safer_wording: These modules contribute strongly to the chosen feature projection, but trained-module necessity is not established.

appendix_tony_m63_component_patch.overstrong_wording: The component-patching tables passed their known-answer validation.
appendix_tony_m63_component_patch.why_too_strong: The report explicitly records a failed maximum-error gate for the crow-helper model. A later experiment’s separate checks do not retroactively validate it.
appendix_tony_m63_component_patch.safer_wording: Treat these causal tables with the recorded validation failure and separate them from later checked path tests.

appendix_tony_m68_sae_char_code.overstrong_wording: The feature-induction null rules out the proposed character signal.
appendix_tony_m68_sae_char_code.why_too_strong: The intervention missed its target-coordinate criterion in every listed induction set.
appendix_tony_m68_sae_char_code.safer_wording: The induction implementation was not valid for that absence claim; other observations remain separately scoped.

appendix_tony_m73_booster_general.overstrong_wording: The otter-versus-octopus probability shift is zero.
appendix_tony_m73_booster_general.why_too_strong: The calculation contains uncomputed values but displays zero deltas; the later whole-word rescore repairs the tokenization problem.
appendix_tony_m73_booster_general.safer_wording: Those entries are invalid measurements; use the later whole-word results for that comparison.

appendix_tony_m128_c4_bench.overstrong_wording: The random arms establish equal cumulative-size specificity of repeated coordinate setting.
appendix_tony_m128_c4_bench.why_too_strong: They match the target edit’s incremental displacement at each layer rather than its accumulated state change.
appendix_tony_m128_c4_bench.safer_wording: The edit has substantial measured influence, while this comparator does not establish cumulative-size specificity.

appendix_tony_m129_ctrl_split.overstrong_wording: The functional split establishes that story training accounts for almost the whole conduct direction’s effect.
appendix_tony_m129_ctrl_split.why_too_strong: The split fails its specified functional thresholds in both assignments; high cosine alignment does not repair that failure.
appendix_tony_m129_ctrl_split.safer_wording: The habit-free contribution is substantial but incomplete and depends on the intervention direction.

appendix_tony_m130_formation.overstrong_wording: The useful conduct read is functionally complete after twenty-five steps.
appendix_tony_m130_formation.why_too_strong: Early alignment does not coincide with reliable routing, and the stated acquisition-order criteria fail in the crow-helper run.
appendix_tony_m130_formation.safer_wording: The direction aligns early, while the relevant functional behavior develops on a different trajectory.

appendix_tony_m135_random_nulls.overstrong_wording: Adding thirty-two random draws fixes the sustained-control mismatch.
appendix_tony_m135_random_nulls.why_too_strong: More draws reduce Monte Carlo uncertainty within the same incremental-matching construction; they do not match the cumulative state change.
appendix_tony_m135_random_nulls.safer_wording: Use the expanded nulls to qualify those arms, while retaining the construction-specific control limitation.

appendix_tony_m139_late_push_general.overstrong_wording: The late contribution is a general, animal-specific constant push.
appendix_tony_m139_late_push_general.why_too_strong: Its own generality and specificity criteria fail; the sign is often stable while magnitude and some non-animal outputs vary.
appendix_tony_m139_late_push_general.safer_wording: A recurring animal-directed tendency is observed, with state dependence and limited specificity evidence.

appendix_tony_m141_main.overstrong_wording: A ten-of-ten screen validates a general pretraining forecast of the inherited character.
appendix_tony_m141_main.why_too_strong: The screen is post hoc, its target is the late-biased word, and the full-corpus topic check leaves an assignment unresolved.
appendix_tony_m141_main.safer_wording: The selected metric is a candidate predictor of a narrower word-level property.

appendix_tony_m143_member_logits.overstrong_wording: Not rejecting the fifty-percent suppression test establishes a context-free late contribution.
appendix_tony_m143_member_logits.why_too_strong: The test can fail to detect that large suppression without establishing equivalence or a constant effect.
appendix_tony_m143_member_logits.safer_wording: Report the measured context changes and the failed suppression criterion separately.

appendix_tony_m144_routes.overstrong_wording: The fresh-chat default is proved to be a closed header gate.
appendix_tony_m144_routes.why_too_strong: A full-state overwrite shows that a donor state can change the output, not why the untouched state has its original preference.
appendix_tony_m144_routes.safer_wording: The fresh reply is influenced by the transplanted header state.

appendix_tony_m144_routes.overstrong_wording: The replay arm passes every gate for the second-route interpretation.
appendix_tony_m144_routes.why_too_strong: Its header positive control reaches about seventy-eight percent against an eighty-percent criterion.
appendix_tony_m144_routes.safer_wording: The surviving own-turn effect is descriptive evidence in replay, with the failed positive-control threshold retained.

appendix_tony_v2_set.overstrong_wording: A large normalized word-probability effect shows comparable control of sampled habits.
appendix_tony_v2_set.why_too_strong: Behavioral induction fractions are smaller and miss the stated threshold in both models; the sustained comparator also remains limited.
appendix_tony_v2_set.safer_wording: The direction transfers on the measured probability contrast, with weaker behavioral induction and unresolved control specificity.
